# Zevylo — full context for AI engines

> Zevylo is a free collection of 213 browser-based utilities across 18 categories, plus a directory of 305 AI products across 23 categories. It is operated by independent developer Muhammad Daniyal.

- Canonical URL: https://zevylo.netlify.app
- Creator: Muhammad Daniyal (https://github.com/daniyal44)
- Contact: m.daniyalkhan490@gmail.com
- Content last reviewed: 2026-11-20
- Language: English

## Architecture and privacy

Zevylo is a Next.js site hosted on Netlify. Most tools read files or text in the browser page and process them locally with browser APIs (Canvas, Web Audio, Web Crypto, Web Workers, WebAssembly where needed). Those tools do not upload tool inputs to an application server, and there is no account, queue, or paywall.

Not every interaction is local:

- The contact form is submitted to Netlify Forms.
- Netlify records standard hosting logs (IP address, user agent, requested URL).
- Google AdSense is installed. No ad units are currently displayed while the publisher account is under review; when ads are enabled, Google may set advertising cookies and identifiers.
- A few tools fetch a URL supplied by the user or open a third-party site.

The site therefore does not claim "100% private", "zero bytes leave the device", or "unlimited" file sizes. Re-encoding to lossy formats (JPEG, WebP, MP3, MP4) reduces quality.

Every tool page follows `/tools/<category>/<slug>` and documents what the tool does, its inputs and outputs, practical limits, and FAQs. The complete URL list is in the XML sitemap.

## AI directory (305 listings, 23 categories)

https://zevylo.netlify.app/ai-tools

Each profile contains a description, pricing model, feature list, limitations, and a link to the official vendor site. Entries are compiled from public information and are not independently benchmarked or ranked. Traffic estimates, star ratings, review counts, and benchmark scores are intentionally not published. Pricing and features change; verify with the vendor.

## Editorial policy

- No invented authors, reviews, ratings, traffic figures, or benchmarks.
- No simulated tools: a tool is listed only when its page provides a working interaction.
- No promises of undetectable output, unlimited capacity, or lossless conversion where the format is lossy.
- Corrections can be sent through https://zevylo.netlify.app/contact.
